submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit IMAGE 1, one existing full-body transparent game sprite, retaining its whole canvas framing, exact body scale, head, hair, face expression, crown, both arms/hands, FIVE talismans in anatomical RIGHT hand and one bell in LEFT hand, clothes, all props and all other pixels as closely as possible. IMAGE 2 is committed fire talisman boy identity. IMAGE 3 is SW committed idle direction identity. IMAGE 4 is confirmed material/style reference. IMAGE 5 is motion anatomy only (no green costume/bow copying). The boy faces and runs SOUTHWEST, toward screen lower-left. Preserve current support leg location, body height and run phase. Change only raised REAR anatomical LEFT ankle and black-red-gold shoe at screen right. The current toe cap swings out to screen right: correct this ankle external rotation. Keep the bent knee and ankle location behind him but turn the shoe naturally with the leg into its sagittal running plane: heel at upper-right, front toe cap down-left from the heel; no splayed-out toe cap to lower-right. The ankle must flow into shoe collar without a sharp sideways kink. Keep the folded calf, no straightening of the bent knee, no crossed legs, exactly two legs. Raised shoe should be a natural slim three-quarter profile, not a giant outsole aimed at the viewer. The planted RIGHT shoe and ground-contact height are unchanged. Only a localized anatomical correction, do not redraw a different run pose. Output one transparent PNG full 1024x1024 or larger square canvas; no floor, no shadow, no text, no grid. Fine polished Q Chinese Taoist fantasy art matching image1. This is frame 8, preserve its distinct support position.
